package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for route_param_name_and_dto_field_name_drift_without_mapping_helper: Repeated manual renaming between route params and DTO fields that lacks a shared mapper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type UserRequest struct {
	UserID    int    `json:"user_id"`
	AccountID int    `json:"account_id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
}

func GetUser(c *gin.Context) {
	var req UserRequest
	req.UserID, _ = strconv.Atoi(c.Param("user-id"))
	req.AccountID, _ = strconv.Atoi(c.Param("account-id"))
	req.Name = c.Query("display-name")
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, req)
}

func UpdateUser(c *gin.Context) {
	var req UserRequest
	req.UserID, _ = strconv.Atoi(c.Param("user-id"))
	req.Name = c.Param("display-name")
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, req)
}
